summary: I re-checked the fix for the main admin login (pedidosconustedes@gmail.com) in the DB, the API and the UI, and it works. Only one users doc has that email: 6ae34bf6c4b986a63025ed26, an owner with no parent_id and is_main=true. It is not locked (failed_logins 0, locked_until null). Its businesses are Verde and Flores menchu, with 51 orders and 5 couriers. The demo account 6ae347236362b29c3e2fb5c8 has its email admin@delivery.com back. The unique index uniq_role_email (partial: email is a string) exists. I made one deliberate wrong-password login for the real email: it returned 401 'Credenciales inválidas', and failed_logins on the REAL doc went to 1, which proves login now checks that account. I reset it to 0 straight away. A login with an email that doesn't exist also returns 401. With a JWT I minted for the real id, /auth/me returns is_main=true and /businesses lists Verde and Flores menchu (no demo businesses). A raw insert of a duplicate owner raises DuplicateKeyError and nothing is left behind. POST /api/admins with the real email (lower or upper case) returns 409. After a backend restart the real account's password_hash is unchanged and no owner is created; the full state diff before and after was empty. admin@delivery.com/Admin12345 logs in and sees Café Aroma, Pizzería Napoli and Farmacia Central. UI at 390x844: the Admin tab logs in as admin@delivery.com. For a linked secondary admin, Gestión shows only the Comercios and Repartidores tabs, with 0 delete-courier buttons and no 'Agregar repartidor'; the main admin sees 2 delete buttons (44x44). The Órdenes range picker has 16px side padding and the summary reads '1 pedido · ...' for one order. Backend: 15/15 iteration-17 tests passed (one test had a wrong expectation and was corrected), and the iteration-16 regression suite passed 10/10. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: ADMIN_EMAIL is the real user's email but ADMIN_PASSWORD is still the public 'Admin12345'. On a fresh DB (for example a production deploy where the real account does not exist yet), seed() creates pedidosconustedes@gmail.com with password Admin12345 plus demo data, so anyone who knows the default could log in as the main admin. Also, admin@delivery.com is no longer seeded, so tests depend on the existing preview DB.

The index is per (role, email), but /auth/login looks up role IN [owner, business]. Cross-role uniqueness relies only on app-level checks (POST /admins, PUT /businesses/{bid}/account), so a race could still create an owner and a business with the same email and make login ambiguous. Low risk.

ui_bugs.component: Órdenes range summary / courier rows / home business cards
ui_bugs.issue: Plural agreement is missing: 'N entregados' and 'N cancelados' show plural for 1 (e.g. '1 entregados'), and '1 activas' appears in the Gestión courier meta and on the home business cards. Only 'pedido/pedidos' is pluralized.

action_items: Change ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend/.env to a strong value that is not public, or make seed() skip creating the main admin when ADMIN_EMAIL is the real user's email, so a fresh/production DB never gets pedidosconustedes@gmail.com/Admin12345.
Optional: fix plural agreement for 'entregados', 'cancelados' and 'activas' (use the existing plural() helper).
critical_code_review_comments: check_login now checks the right doc because there is a single owner with the real email, and the lockout counter was confirmed to apply to 6ae34bf6.
seed() returns early when the ADMIN_EMAIL owner already has businesses, so it does not touch the real account's data or password.
The linked secondary admin is hidden from courier delete in the UI (manage.tsx:216) and blocked by the API (DELETE /couriers returns 403 via account_admin).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Do NOT rerun TestRealLogin::test_one_wrong_password_401_and_counter_increments casually: it makes one wrong login on the real user's account (it resets afterwards). Use -k 'not test_one_wrong_password'. The pytest.ini adds xdist (-n). Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The real user is actively using the preview: the linked admin jmgs48642@gmail.com (parent 6ae34bf6) was created and then deleted through the API with the real account's token during this session (log line 'DELETE /api/admins/6ae75cc974b3dfb806642c49'). Agents did not do that. Another owner, mazzarrir@gamil.com (no parent), also exists; leave it alone.
rca_of_issue: Confirmed fixed. Before: two owner docs had the same email and login's find_one returned the demo doc, so the real password was checked against the wrong hash. Now: the demo email is restored, the unique index blocks duplicates, and the failed_logins increment on 6ae34bf6 after a wrong attempt proves login resolves to the real account.
